gloss: to run aground; to run up onto (a curb); to hit a snag

definitions.gloss: to run aground; to run up onto (a curb)
definitions.explanation: Of a ship or vehicle: to run onto something that stops or tilts it, such as a reef, a sandbank or a curb.

definitions.gloss: to hit a snag ({暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる)
definitions.explanation: Figurative, mainly in {暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: of plans or negotiations, to run into an obstacle and stall.

examples.english: The ship ran onto the rocks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げて⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The car ran up onto the sidewalk and stopped.
In thick fog, a fishing boat ran aground on a shoal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げた→暗礁に乗り上げる：16533_anshouninoriageru⟧。
⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げている→暗礁に乗り上げる：16533_anshouninoriageru⟧。
examples.english: The plan has stalled for lack of funds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{領土|りょうど}→領土：15711_ryoudo⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧をめぐって⟦{暗礁|あんしょう}に{乗|の}り{上|あ}げた→暗礁に乗り上げる：16533_anshouninoriageru⟧ままだ。
examples.english: Talks between the two countries remain stalled over the territorial dispute.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive; the thing run onto takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗礁|あんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: to run onto a hidden reef; (figurative) to hit a snag
- ⟦{浅瀬|あさせ}→浅瀬：15720_asase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: to run aground on a shoal
- ⟦{縁石|えんせき}→縁石：08401_enseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乗|の}り{上|あ}げる: to run up onto the curb

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {座礁|ざしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run aground (ships only; news and official language)
- {行|ゆ}き{詰|づ}まる: to reach a deadlock (figurative)
